question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Witty
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stupid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of another word.
 
• **Witty **means having a clever sense of humour or quick wit. (विनोदपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: His witty remarks always make me smile.
